question: What offense is committed against a guru who imparts even a single syllable?
premises: The guru is described as a giver of one syllable.
A person may act disrespectfully toward such a guru.
The verse identifies this act of disrespect.
inference: Disrespecting a guru who gives even a single syllable is condemned.
plain_english: Whoever disrespects a guru who imparts even a single syllable commits a grave offense.
